verdict.rationale: Fivetran ships its own AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI and GitHub Copilot CLI, so connectors can be built, tested and deployed from natural-language prompts, producing Python code the user can review before deploying. The evidence does not show the AI drafting from API documentation or handling auth, pagination and streams, and it depends on third-party agents. Missing for 10: documented generation from API docs, explicit auth, pagination and stream scaffolding, a review step in the workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI drafts a working connector from API documentation — auth, pagination, streams — that I review and ship

citations.quote: We provide AI coding agent plugins that add Connector SDK-specific skills to Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot CLI. These skills let you build, test, and deploy connectors using natural language prompts.
Fivetran’s Connector SDK allows you to develop a custom data connector using Python and deploy it as an extension of Fivetran.
